top_signals.title: Oil shipments are under attack on multiple fronts as fighting escalates in Red Sea, Hormuz and Black Sea
top_signals.summary: More than 60 commercial ships have been attacked in the Persian Gulf, Strait of Hormuz and Gulf of Oman since March 1.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
